territorial.models: Freeze every numerical kernel, auxiliary variant, rank, prior, variance-replication settings and convergence/retry rules using2019/2025 development only. external_protocol.information_budget: All methods receive the same frozen district auxiliaries and training responses; Hogg additionally uses training age/sex, explicitly disclosed as a stronger information arm. No unverified child-population margins are invented.
external_protocol.district_eligibility: For each endpoint, include every matched target district with at least one valid positive-weight outcome and finite means from all three prescribed methods. Report every unscorable or administrative-excluded district and reason. No minimum count/PSU gate added after scores are seen.
external_protocol.primary_score: Within-district design-weighted marginal child binary cross-entropy, averaged equally over eligible target districts, separately by endpoint; arithmetic direct mean is sufficient. Numerical probability floor1e-12, affected cells reported.
secondary_scores: RMSE against noisy district direct means, never latent true prevalence
Brier score including within-district binary expectation
Temporal and territorial subgroups fixed by sampled2019 versus unsampled2019; no favorable subgroup-only claim
external_protocol.primary_contrasts: BetaDesignUncertainty minus each of BetaPowerExisting and HoggAgeSexSpatial, separately for anemia/stunting and temporal/territorial tasks: fixed family8.
external_protocol.primary_inference: Cluster sandwich SE for equal-district mean loss differences with province clusters, small-sample multiplierJ/(J-1), t reference dfJ-1, two-sidedP and Holm adjustment over fixed8. Lower score is favorable; all8 retained regardless of direction or significance. This is superpopulation province-cluster inference, not exact randomization or latent coverage.
external_protocol.uncertainty_sensitivity: Paired province bootstrap3999 repetitions; resample all districts in each selected province, same bootstrap index for all methods, seed202610072024; unadjusted95percentile intervals explicitly descriptive.
external_protocol.failure_policy: Prespecified numerical retry only; no retuning because2024 scores are weak. Failed fit task remains failed and cannot be excluded to make candidate win. Reserved scores withheld until all three valid predictions are locked or an explicit failed-task amendment is recorded.
external_protocol.publication_claims: Cannot ensure superiority or acceptance. Report adverse temporal drift, adverse comparators, numerical failures and uncertainty without favorable filtering.

design_protocol.mixture_weights: eight equal fixed empirical weights, not reweighted by model evidence or likelihood; select first8 indices of permutation of1024 from state_seed, first16 for sensitivity
design_protocol.posterior_target: conditional beta-power hyperposterior for each fixed global effective-n vector; CUT mixture of normalized conditional posteriors
design_protocol.formula_score: u_id = sum(child in PSU i and domain d) w_j*(y_j-p_d)/sum(domain observed weights)
design_protocol.formula_contribution: c_id = m_h/(m_h-1)*(u_id-mean_i_in_full_stratum(u_id))^2 for m_h>=2; c_id=u_id^2 for m_h=1
design_protocol.formula_taylor: V_d=sum_all_full_frame_PSUs(c_id); empty-domain PSUs carry zero scores but centered contributions need not be zero
design_protocol.replicate_formula: C_bhi~Multinomial(m_h;1/m_h); V_bhd=m_h^2/(m_h-1)^2*[sum_i C_bhi*u_hid^2-(sum_i C_bhi*u_hid)^2/m_h] for m_h>=2. Sum full strata plus fixed singleton components. Exact conditional expectation equals observed Taylor variance.
design_protocol.replicated_target_limitation: first-order conditional linearized-PSU empirical bootstrap variance; observed linearized PSU scores held fixed but recentred inside each resample. Not Rao-Wu weights, not full nonlinear ratio bootstrap or a nested bootstrap; conditional response and lower-stage uncertainty omitted
design_protocol.singleton_default: C_bhi=1 for m_h=1; observed lonely-adjust Taylor component fixed; uncertainty unidentified and not propagated
design_protocol.singleton_sensitivity: optional explicit assumption scenarios fixed-certainty removal or independent 0/2 pseudo multiplier; never claim design identification
design_protocol.response: fixed observed outcome availability and original outcome-specific weights; no refit of response model and no correction of MNAR
design_protocol.gvf_eligibility: training domains with direct0<p<1, positive finite Taylor contribution above1e-15, at least two observed PSUs; require at least five stable domains
design_protocol.gvf_weights: max(nPSU_d-nRepresentedStrata_d,1), ridge1 on slopes, intercept unpenalized; predictor centering/scaling from eligible training domains only
design_protocol.pstar: observed p for interior0<p<1; Jeffreys surrogate(nKish*p+0.5)/(nKish+1) only for zero/one variance-scale stabilization
design_protocol.variance_stabilization: Vstar_d=a_d*V_d+(1-a_d)*V_GVF_d, a_d=dfProxy/(dfProxy+4), dfProxy=max(nPSU-nRepresentedStrata,0); set a_d=0 at direct zero/one
design_protocol.boundaries: original direct0/1 retained in all power-likelihood exponents, no added success/failure, no domain discarded because of direct boundary
design_protocol.priors_and_spatial_basis: unchanged frozen statistical priors and spectral basis; q40 ENDES, q12 simulations
design_protocol.state_seed_offsets: shared underlying stratum replication and state indices for both independently fitted outcomes; endpoint MCMC seeds distinct; states retain global cross-domain dependence
design_protocol.mcmc_seed_formula: 20261007 + year*100 + (10000 if territorial_training else0) + (state_index_zero_based*100003); inherited endpoint+1009 and retry+104729 offsets, all uint32 valid
design_protocol.performance_selection: no tuning on reserved-year or territorial held-out responses; no discard of failed states to improve performance; failure reported and predeclared retry only
design_protocol.outer_integration_sensitivity: CUT16 first16 of same prespecified permutation, only2019full optional extension; first8 shared with primaryCUT8, no best-state selection; explicit root dispatch flag required
design_protocol.reproduction_scope: phase2 sources and outputs only; original sources, frozen16 kernels, archived documents and ZIP untouched
